Taxonomy.destinationsDescription: Country → region → city tree. The key is used in tour filter URLs and is fixed once published.
Taxonomy.travelStylesDescription: Styles such as honeymoon, family or wellness. Each language is published separately.
Taxonomy.policiesDescription: Refund rules by days before departure. Bookings keep a snapshot of the policy they were made under.
Taxonomy.keyHint: Lower case without accents, e.g. ha-long-bay. Cannot change once published.
Taxonomy.statusHint: A public page shows only when the destination is published and that language is published too.
Taxonomy.heroAltMissing: This image is missing its Vietnamese or English alt text.
Taxonomy.name: Name
Taxonomy.summaryHint: One or two sentences; used on cards and as the search description when SEO is empty.
Taxonomy.localeEmptyHint: Leave the name empty if there is no translation yet; that language will not show.
Taxonomy.deleteBody: This cannot be undone. Only possible when no tour or child item uses it.
Taxonomy.slugTakenNow: Another item already uses this URL.
Taxonomy.rulesHint: From the earliest to the latest cancellation; the last line is 0 days (cancelling right before departure).
Taxonomy.usedBy: {count, plural, one {Used by # tour} other {Used by # tours}}

errors.slugInvalid: Use only lower-case letters without accents, digits and hyphens.
errors.keyInvalid: Use only lower-case letters without accents, digits and hyphens.
errors.daysOrder: Days must decrease from one rule to the next.
errors.refundOrder: A later cancellation cannot refund more.
errors.lastRuleDayZero: The last rule must be 0 days.
errors.key_locked: The key cannot change once published.
errors.slug_taken: Another item already uses this URL.
errors.invalid_parent: Invalid parent: regions sit under countries, cities under regions.
errors.hero_alt_missing: The main image needs Vietnamese and English alt text before publishing.
errors.failed: Could not save. Please try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.in_use: Used by tours or child items, so it cannot be deleted.
errors.default_required: There must always be a default policy. Make another policy the default first.
errors.is_default: The default policy cannot be deleted. Make another policy the default first.
errors.default_not_moved: The policy was saved but could not be made the default. Please try again.
errors.contentImageAlt: Images in the content need Vietnamese and English alt text before publishing.

Taxonomy.defaultHint: The default policy cannot be unticked; make another policy the default instead.
Taxonomy.contentHint: Optional. When empty, the destination page uses the summary.
